question: Does Cults3d impose a 1 GB per-upload file-size limit as stated in the record's free-tier and reliability text?
why: The first-party AI-filtering page states only a daily upload-count limit; a broker search lead (omnvert, 2026-10-01) reports Cults3D publishes no official per-file limit and the Cults FAQ names only a 30 MB OBJ viewer limit, so the 1 GB figure is not established on a first-party page.
